title: Sara Duterte's tree planting 'connection' with Calle88 questioned in impeachment trial
summary: The House prosecution panel raised questions Friday regarding the alleged possible connection of Vice President Sara Duterte's tree planting activities with Cale88 Foods Corporation.

blocks.text: The House prosecution panel raised questions Friday regarding the alleged possible connection of Vice President Sara Duterte's tree planting activities with Cale88 Foods Corporation.

Cale88, the food firm linked to Duterte's husband Manases Carpio, has come under scrutiny during the vice president's impeachment trial over its profits earned with only two employees and its supposed financial inflows from China.
During the cross examination of Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo on Day 45 of the trial, private prosecutor Erwin Matib flashed photos of Duterte planting trees.
The defense counsel initially objected on the basis of relevance, but Presiding Officer Francis Escudero allowed Matib to continue, granted that he is on a short leash.

"Tama po ba na itong pagtatanim ng mga puno ni Vice President Sara Duterte ay connected sa pag-comply ng Cale88 Foods sa tree planting activities na requirement ng Board of Investment? In fact, ang requirement ng Board of Investment ay magtanim dapat ang enterprises ng at least 100 forest trees. May ganoong requirement, tama po ba?" Matib said.

(Is it correct that Vice President Sara Duterte tree planting is connected with with Cale88's compliance with the tree planting requirements of the Board of Investment? In fact, the requirement of the Board of Investment is to plant at least 100 forest trees. There is a requirement for this, right?)
Before Rodolfo could answer, defense counsel Justin Gular objected.

"Objection, your honor, misleading. There is no prior testimony coming from the witness wherein he testified that the vice president participated in the compliance requirement of tree planting," Gullar said.

"The insinuation being made by the prosecution that the pictures being shown or that was displayed of the vice president planting trees had any relation to Cale88 Foods Corporation's registration is misleading, malicious and callous, your honor," he added.
Escudero sustained Gular's objection, telling Matib to carry on to the next point.
Rodolfo affirmed that tree planting was part of Board of Investment's (BOI) requirements. — VDV, GMA News
